description: This PHP source file defines an EmployeeListener class that hooks into Doctrine ORM lifecycle events related to Employee entities, primarily to handle encryption and decryption of SSN numbers during entity updates and loading.

classes.name: EmployeeListener
classes.description: A listener class for handling encryption and decryption of Employee entity SSN numbers during lifecycle events in Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the SSN number of an Employee before the entity is updated in the database if encryption is enabled and the SSN field has changed.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the SSN number of an Employee after the entity has been updated in the database if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the SSN number of an Employee after it has been loaded from the database if encryption is enabled.
